dialogues.speaker: Toda
dialogues.text: Ah, you noticed... I've heard from the shrine maidens that more and more people wish to abolish the Sakoku Decree.

dialogues.speaker: Toda
dialogues.text: If the Sakoku Decree cannot bring happiness to Inazuma, what kind of impact will it have on the other nations in Teyvat...

dialogues.speaker: Toda
dialogues.text: ...I don't really have a conclusion for now. But as a member of the Yashiro Commission, all I can do is trust in the Almighty Shogun.

dialogues.speaker: Toda
dialogues.text: If it is the Shogun's decision, then it must be beneficial to Eternity...
